summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of 140,000 Class B ordinary shares to its Chairman and CEO, Pengfei Jiang, at par value ($0.0025/share, total $350). The Class B shares carry 30 votes each, granting Jiang approximately 64.0% of total voting power. The board approved the issuance as a related-party transaction, reviewed by the Audit Committee, citing the desire to deter hostile takeovers and strengthen management stability. The filing also notes committee chairmanship changes, with an independent director appointed to lead the Audit Committee. No pending acquisition or takeover attempt was disclosed. The issuance is a routine governance/anti-takeover measure, not a special situation.
